name: foloprint-design-studio
description: Standalone proof-of-concept product design studio for print-on-demand products

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @foloprint/shared && npm run build -w @foloprint/renderer
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @foloprint/api && npm run build -w @foloprint/web
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:api
